title: Template compiled from input (python) — review required
description: A python template engine compiles a template built from parts: render_template_string(tpl + name). Template syntax in the input executes with the application's authority. This lexical rule flags the compilation; the reviewer confirms the template is fixed or sandboxed.
remediation: Compile fixed templates only and pass input as variables (render_template with variables); never build template source from input.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any assembled template matches, including trusted ones.
